scope: Extend the existing software recovery owner before reusing it for ABI-16 transport; no new hardware controller or backend owner

recovery_client.intent: Record Pending(epoch) before the MMIO request write; uncertain write/status/epoch-read errors retain query-only authority,not replay or reopen
recovery_client.terminal: Hardware failure,protocol-invalid post-request status or wrong completion epoch latches software failure; later status cannot become Ready
recovery_client.incarnation: Bind requests/reopen to the mailbox epoch; only correlated next-epoch reset completion advances it; stale mailbox recreation cannot adopt/request another epoch
recovery_client.completion: Hardware reset complete only,not application Ready,semantic handoff,continuing-lease reuse or cancellation

verification.actual_axi_scope: Existing legacy ABI15 recovery pipeline,real B/status-R acceptance before injected software error,genuine epoch1-to2 reset completion,replay/stale-mailbox refusal,no synthetic audio quantum. Not new ABI16 attachment,permanent MMIO stall or held-DDR-drain proof; existing actual-DDR/held-response suites pass separately.

retained_expected_pre_fix_regressions.cause: Old client loses pending authority after uncertain ACK and permits later success after terminal status
Initial intent/terminal fix still permits stale mailbox to adopt new epoch; incarnation binding added

reproduce_narrow: nix develop --command bash -c 'export SHOOP_FPGA_SOURCE_ROOT="$PWD"; RUSTFLAGS="-D warnings" cargo test -p rt_fpga_rtl --features sim,rt-interface --test host_recovery --test recovery_pipeline -- --test-threads=1'
